import importlib,json,os,sys,unittest
from pathlib import Path
from scratch_builder import guard
from investigation_io import write_json
names=['tools.new1_construction_diag','tools.new1_identity_diag','tools.new1_geometry','tools.new1_supervisor','tools.mathlab_admit','tools.mathlab_runtime','tools.mathlab_events','tests.test_new1_construction_diag','tests.test_new1_identity_diag','tests.test_new1_geometry','tests.test_new1_supervisor']
modules=[importlib.import_module(n) for n in names]
rows=guard(modules,Path.cwd())
suites=names[-4:]
suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromNames(suites)
record={'phase':'step2-import-check','loaded_modules':rows,'method_count':suite.countTestCases(),'expected_methods':182,'torch_loaded':'torch' in sys.modules}
path=Path(os.environ['NEW1_IMPORT_RECEIPT'])
write_json(path,record)
saved=json.loads(path.read_text())
assert saved['method_count']==182,saved
print(json.dumps({'method_count':saved['method_count'],'modules_inside_scratch':len(rows),'torch_loaded':saved['torch_loaded']}))
